Every LiteRT build the packages run, each pinned to a Hugging Face commit, and for every platform and backend what is known about it. The same data is in [models.json](/models.json). Install a build by name, with no URL to copy:

```dart
await FlutterEdgeAi.installFromCatalog(LiteRtLmModels.gemma4E2bIt.generic).install();
```

| Mark | Meaning |
|---|---|
| ✅ verified | Passed on that host and backend with the native build the packages ship now |
| 🕓 stale | Passed there on an earlier native build; not run since it changed |
| 📝 documented | Documented as working; not yet re-run with a recorded log |
| ⚪ untested | The package runs it there; nobody has recorded a run |
| ⛔ refused | This version of the package does not run it there |
| ⏸️ withheld | Left out of the catalog; the note says why |
| ❌ broken | Known not to work there; see the issue |

A blank cell is a combination that does not exist: a build compiled for one NPU on another platform, a web export on a phone, or a native build on the web. Package versions: `flutter_edge_ai` 2.5.3, `flutter_edge_ai_litertlm` 1.17.1, `flutter_edge_ai_speech` 0.5.11.
